sentences.en: My colleague Sabrina Tabernisi has been reporting on a recent incident in Fort Smith, Arkansas, a mostly white, predominantly Christian town,
sentences.zh: 我的同事萨布丽娜·塔伯尼西一直在报道阿肯色州史密斯堡最近发生的一起事件，那是一个以白人为主、主要信奉基督教的小镇，

sentences.en: where abject poverty lives alongside visible wealth.
sentences.zh: 在那里，赤贫与显而易见的财富并存。

sentences.en: There's a small, little lively population of Muslims in Fort Smith, but for the most part, nobody knew that there were Muslims in Fort Smith.
sentences.zh: 史密斯堡有一个规模虽小但充满活力的穆斯林群体，但大多数人根本不知道史密斯堡有穆斯林。

sentences.en: You know, they were there, but most people didn't know that they were there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们就在那里，但大多数人并不知道他们的存在。

sentences.en: And nothing like this had ever happened before.
sentences.zh: 而且以前从未发生过这样的事。

sentences.en: On the morning of October 20th, the imam at the al-Salam mosque on South 28th Street drove up to prepare for morning prayers and saw that the mosque had been vandalized.
sentences.zh: 10月20日清晨，南28街阿尔萨拉姆清真寺的伊玛目开车去准备晨祷时，发现清真寺遭到了破坏。

sentences.en: There were swastikas on its sign, on its windows and its doors, curses against Islam, curses against Allah.
sentences.zh: 招牌、窗户和门上都被喷上了纳粹万字旗，还有诅咒伊斯兰教和安拉的脏话。

sentences.en: There were words, ugly, ugly writing,
sentences.zh: 上面写着字，丑陋、极其丑陋的字迹，

sentences.en: Muslims go home, we don't want you here.
sentences.zh: “穆斯林滚回家，我们不欢迎你们”。

sentences.en: He then begins calling everybody in the Muslim community, telling them a terrible thing has happened to the mosque.
sentences.zh: 他随即开始给穆斯林社区的每一个人打电话，告诉他们清真寺发生了可怕的事情。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: One of the first of those calls was to Hisham Yassin.
sentences.zh: 他打出的第一批电话中就包括希沙姆·亚辛。

sentences.en: And when he called me, I just came right away.
sentences.zh: 他给我打电话时，我立刻就赶过去了。

sentences.en: He's a used car dealer in Fort Smith and the social director of the al-Salam mosque.
sentences.zh: 他是史密斯堡的一名二手车经销商，也是阿尔萨拉姆清真寺的社交主管。

sentences.en: And Hisham gets in his white infinity, grabs his gun and drives immediately to the mosque.
sentences.zh: 希沙姆开着他的白色英菲尼迪，带上枪，立刻开车赶往清真寺。

sentences.en: Wow, grabs his gun.
sentences.zh: 哇，带上枪。

sentences.en: People were on edge.
sentences.zh: 人们当时都很紧张。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, Trump stuff has been going on.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，特朗普那一套一直在发生。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump, he was up in fire, right and left on MusliMs.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生，他当时对穆斯林火力全开，左右开弓。

sentences.en: We're really worried anyway about what's happening nationally.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，我们真的很担心全国正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Every day.
sentences.zh: 每天都在担心。

sentences.en: There was a guy who'd been sending anonymous emails to the mosque, threatening them.
sentences.zh: 有一个人一直在给清真寺发送匿名邮件，威胁他们。

sentences.en: They had to call the FBI about that.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不为此报警求助FBI。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: You know, for myself, for my family, for my mosque.
sentences.zh: 你知道，为了我自己，为了我的家人，为了我的清真寺。

sentences.en: And so they were pretty freaked out.
sentences.zh: 所以他们当时非常惊恐。

sentences.en: You know, and sometimes I was carrying my gun.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有时我也会带着枪。

sentences.en: You never know.
sentences.zh: 你永远不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: So Hisham shows up, kind of takes control, you know, and sees all of this writing.
sentences.zh: 希沙姆赶到后，算是控制住了局面，他看到了所有的那些涂鸦。

sentences.en: He sees the swastikas.
sentences.zh: 他看到了纳粹万字旗。

sentences.en: He sees, we don't want you here, Muslims, go home.
sentences.zh: 他看到了“我们不欢迎你们，穆斯林，滚回家”。

sentences.en: And he feels incredibly, incredibly sad.
sentences.zh: 他感到无比、无比的悲伤。

sentences.en: Looks like it's something.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是某种预兆。

sentences.en: Somebody hates us.
sentences.zh: 有人恨我们。

sentences.en: And we've been here, me and my family, almost 35 years.
sentences.zh: 我和我的家人在这里已经住了快35年了。

sentences.en: And these people, how can they say these things?
sentences.zh: 而这些人，他们怎么能说出这种话？

sentences.en: Who would do this?
sentences.zh: 谁会做这种事？

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 晚上好。

sentences.en: I'm Chris Wallace of Fox News.
sentences.zh: 我是福克斯新闻的克里斯·华莱士。

sentences.en: So who did do this?
sentences.zh: 那么，到底是谁干的？

sentences.en: So it was the night of the last presidential debate between Trump and a president.
sentences.zh: 那是特朗普和总统之间最后一场总统辩论的当晚。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Chris.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，克里斯。

sentences.en: And thanks to UNLV for hosting us.
sentences.zh: 也感谢内华达大学拉斯维加斯分校主办这次活动。

sentences.en: Three young men drove in a white Ford minivan to two mosques in Fort Smith.
sentences.zh: 三名年轻人开着一辆白色福特面包车去了史密斯堡的两座清真寺。

sentences.en: Craig Wiginton, Abraham Davis, and Ezra Pedraza.
sentences.zh: 克雷格·威金顿、亚伯拉罕·戴维斯和埃兹拉·佩德拉萨。

sentences.en: The only thing I can remember about that night, besides being unbelievably just wasted, the short conversation, I remember, like, bits and pieces of driving.
sentences.zh: 关于那天晚上，除了记得自己喝得烂醉如泥，以及那段简短的对话外，我只记得开车时的一些零碎片段。

sentences.en: The story that Abe tells is they were together, they drink Kentucky Deluxe, which is this very cheap whiskey.
sentences.zh: 阿比讲述的故事是，他们当时在一起，喝了肯塔基豪华威士忌，那是一种非常廉价的酒。

sentences.en: Craig was getting very, very emotional about ISIS.
sentences.zh: 克雷格对ISIS感到非常、非常激动。

sentences.en: As a threat.
sentences.zh: 作为一种威胁。

sentences.en: Well, as, you know, it's outrageous that they're killing American soldiers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，他们杀害美国士兵真是令人发指。

sentences.en: It's outrageous that they're killing children.
sentences.zh: 他们杀害儿童真是令人发指。

sentences.en: Yeah, just pretty much just talking about, like, all the stuff that's going on in the Middle East, all the deaths.
sentences.zh: 是啊，基本上就是在谈论中东发生的所有事情，所有的死亡。

sentences.en: We shouldn't allow them to get away with this stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该让他们逍遥法外。

sentences.en: Let's go retaliate.
sentences.zh: 我们去报复吧。

sentences.en: Let's do something.
sentences.zh: 我们做点什么吧。

sentences.en: 5 News reporter Joe Ellison is live in Fort Smith.
sentences.zh: 5新闻记者乔·埃里森在史密斯堡为您现场报道。

sentences.en: And Joe, there is surveillance video of the vandalism.
sentences.zh: 乔，有关于破坏行为的监控录像吗？

sentences.en: A security camera on one of them captures with just cinematic precision the ringleader, Craig Wiginton.
sentences.zh: 其中一个监控摄像头以电影般的精准度拍下了带头人克雷格·威金顿。

sentences.en: Tall, kind of gangly, in a baseball cap, spraying in spray paint all over the side of his bosque.
sentences.zh: 他个子高高的，有点瘦长，戴着棒球帽，在清真寺侧面到处喷漆。

sentences.en: In the top right corner, you can see two people walk up to the Islamic Prayer Center on South 28th Street.
sentences.zh: 在右上角，你可以看到两个人走向南28街的伊斯兰祈祷中心。

sentences.en: One stays behind where the sign out front was tagged.
sentences.zh: 一个人留在后面，前面的招牌被喷上了标记。

sentences.en: And you see Abraham Davis sort of standing in the driveway, kind of on the lookout type thing.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到亚伯拉罕·戴维斯站在车道上，像是在放哨。

sentences.en: He is 20 at the time.
sentences.zh: 他当时20岁。

sentences.en: He had dropped out of high school.
sentences.zh: 他高中辍学了。

sentences.en: Very, very impressed and enamored of Craig.
sentences.zh: 非常、非常崇拜克雷格，被他迷住了。

sentences.en: Okay, Joe, thanks.
sentences.zh: 好的，乔，谢谢。

sentences.en: If you recognize the person in the video, police encourage you to call the River Valley Crimestoppers line at 7-8-CRIME.
sentences.zh: 如果您认出视频中的人，警方鼓励您拨打河谷灭罪热线7-8-CRIME。

sentences.en: The cops looked and looked.
sentences.zh: 警察找了又找。

sentences.en: There were a couple of false leads.
sentences.zh: 有几条错误的线索。

sentences.en: And then in February, they got a call from a kid who had been at a party with Craig.
sentences.zh: 然后在二月份，他们接到了一个孩子的电话，他曾和克雷格一起参加过派对。

sentences.en: And this kid said, I think that Craig Wiginton was the one who defaced the mosque.
sentences.zh: 这个孩子说，我觉得克雷格·威金顿就是那个破坏清真寺的人。

sentences.en: And he was with Abraham and Ezra.
sentences.zh: 而且他和亚伯拉罕还有埃兹拉在一起。

sentences.en: And he actually told me that he wanted to go back and burn it down.
sentences.zh: 他甚至告诉我，他想回去把清真寺烧了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I remember that night because I was frantic.
sentences.zh: 我记得那天晚上，因为我当时快疯了。

sentences.en: And Abraham, two policemen, came to his door, to his mom's house, Kristen's house, and knocked on the door.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕，两名警察来到了他家，他妈妈克里斯汀的家，敲了敲门。

sentences.en: They said, hey, is Abraham Davis here?
sentences.zh: 他们说，嘿，亚伯拉罕·戴维斯在吗？

sentences.en: And we're like, no, he's not right now.
sentences.zh: 我们说，不，他现在不在。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 怎么了？

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 发生什么事了？

sentences.en: We have a $15,000 warrant for Abraham's arreSt.
sentences.zh: 我们有一张针对亚伯拉罕的1.5万美元逮捕令。

sentences.en: Noah, his brother, knew where he was.
sentences.zh: 他的兄弟诺亚知道他在哪儿。

sentences.en: And he called his brother.
sentences.zh: 他给兄弟打了电话。

sentences.en: He said, hey, man, cops just came and ransacked the whole house.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，伙计，警察刚来把家里翻了个底朝天。

sentences.en: They're looking for you.
sentences.zh: 他们在找你。

sentences.en: You got like a $15,000 warrant for your arreSt.
sentences.zh: 你有一张1.5万美元的逮捕令。

sentences.en: I'm just sitting here like, what?
sentences.zh: 我当时坐在那儿，心想，什么？

sentences.en: And, yeah, he gives himself up.
sentences.zh: 然后，是的，他自首了。

sentences.en: He drives to jail, stops by the house to say goodbye to his mother.
sentences.zh: 他开车去监狱，顺路回了趟家向母亲告别。

sentences.en: He said, I'm basically here to say goodbye for right now.
sentences.zh: 他说，我基本上是来暂时告别的。

sentences.en: That was a bad moment.
sentences.zh: 那是一个糟糕的时刻。

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: He was white as a ghoSt.
sentences.zh: 他脸色惨白如鬼。

sentences.en: And he was shaking.
sentences.zh: 他在发抖。

sentences.en: And he gave me a hug.
sentences.zh: 他给了我一个拥抱。

sentences.en: And when he did, I just, it was like a dam that broke.
sentences.zh: 当他拥抱我时，我感觉就像大坝决堤了一样。

sentences.en: I mean, seriously, that's what I felt like.
sentences.zh: 我是说真的，我当时就是这种感觉。

sentences.en: I've never seen my mother cry like that.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过我母亲那样哭泣。

sentences.en: She cried like a woman who just got the news that her son died.
sentences.zh: 她哭得像个刚接到儿子死讯的女人。

sentences.en: You know, like a mother would have, like, getting the news, like, if her son had went out to war and the two guys in the car show up at her house.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像一个母亲接到消息，如果她的儿子去打仗了，然后两个男人出现在她家门口那样。

sentences.en: And she's, she just lost everything.
sentences.zh: 她感觉失去了一切。

sentences.en: Here was this kid that I knew was, you know, not going down the right path.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个我知道没走上正道的孩子。

sentences.en: And I wanted him to do something different with his life.
sentences.zh: 我希望他能为自己的人生做点不同的事。

sentences.en: And I'm just, like, trying to hold on to him to try to get him to say, God, would you just turn this way and go down this way instead of going this way?
sentences.zh: 我只是试图抓住他，想让他说，天哪，你能不能转个弯，走这条路，而不是走那条路？

sentences.en: I mean, come on, you're, the way you're going, you're screwing your life up.
sentences.zh: 我是说，拜托，你现在走的路是在毁掉你的人生。

sentences.en: She was so sad and so just completely broken that this had happened to her kid.
sentences.zh: 她当时非常难过，完全被孩子发生这种事给击垮了。

sentences.en: And I was, like, going, okay, are you, are you sure this, are you sure they got the, and he's like, mom, I've seen all the evidence.
sentences.zh: 我当时在想，好吧，你确定吗？你确定他们拿到了……他说，妈，我看了所有的证据。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's me.
sentences.zh: 是的，是我。

sentences.en: I was, I was in on this.
sentences.zh: 我参与了这件事。

sentences.en: And I'm like, and so you just kind of take a deep breath and then you, and then your next focus is, okay, so what's the next step?
sentences.zh: 我心想，好吧，你只能深吸一口气，然后你的下一个重点是，好吧，下一步该怎么办？

sentences.en: And, um, he's like, well, ma'am, you know, this is a charge and his bond is like 15,000.
sentences.zh: 然后，他说，嗯，女士，你知道，这是一项指控，保释金是1.5万。

sentences.en: And I'm just, like, going, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，天哪。

sentences.en: Holy crap.
sentences.zh: 该死。

sentences.en: I said I couldn't get him out if I wanted to.
sentences.zh: 我说就算我想救他出来也做不到。

sentences.en: I mean, seriously, I mean, that's.
sentences.zh: 我是说真的，我是说……

sentences.en: Because what was the bail?
sentences.zh: 因为保释金是多少？

sentences.en: Bail would have been 10% of 15,000, which is 1,500.
sentences.zh: 保释金是1.5万的10%，也就是1500。

sentences.en: Actually, it would have been 1580.
sentences.zh: 实际上应该是1580。

sentences.en: Because 10% is what the bail bonds would take.
sentences.zh: 因为10%是保释金公司收取的费用。

sentences.en: And then the state charges like a, I don't know, a fee of some sort of $80 just to get him out.
sentences.zh: 然后州政府还会收取某种80美元的费用，才能让他出来。

sentences.en: And I couldn't do that.
sentences.zh: 我根本做不到。

sentences.en: There was just no way, ever.
sentences.zh: 根本不可能。

sentences.en: What you need to understand about Abraham's family is that they have a combined income of about $1,700 a month, which needs to cover gas, their $700 a month rent,
sentences.zh: 你需要了解的是，亚伯拉罕一家的月总收入约为1700美元，这需要支付汽油费、每月700美元的房租，

sentences.en: which they're always behind on, and three boys, Abraham, Noah, and Gabriel.
sentences.zh: 他们总是拖欠房租，还要养三个男孩：亚伯拉罕、诺亚和加布里埃尔。

sentences.en: One of the weeks I was there, their water was cut off.
sentences.zh: 我在那儿待的其中一周，他们家被停水了。

sentences.en: They were two days late for their water bill, in part because they were juggling being able to pay a phone bill.
sentences.zh: 他们拖欠了水费，迟交了两天，部分原因是他们还要竭力凑钱支付电话费。

sentences.en: Did his mother work?
sentences.zh: 他母亲工作吗？

sentences.en: She worked in a fish tackle plant where she would paint eyes on fishing lures.
sentences.zh: 她在一家渔具厂工作，负责给鱼饵画上眼睛。

sentences.en: But she was diagnosed in 2014 with leukemia and went on disability a couple of months later and has been on disability since then.
sentences.zh: 但她在2014年被诊断出患有白血病，几个月后就开始领取残疾补助，从那以后一直靠补助生活。

sentences.en: Her husband, Kenny, who is the stepdad of Abraham and Noah, worked maintenance at McDonald's for many years, cleaning, sort of draining the grease from the drains.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫肯尼，也就是亚伯拉罕和诺亚的继父，在麦当劳做了多年维修工，负责清洁工作，比如清理排水管里的油脂。

sentences.en: And then most recently was working at Cole's department store and was diagnosed with Parkinson's and actually has a pretty advanced stage of Parkinson's.
sentences.zh: 最近他是在科尔百货公司工作，后来被诊断出患有帕金森病，而且病情已经相当严重了。

sentences.en: So he could no longer fold a shirt.
sentences.zh: 所以他连衬衫都叠不了了。

sentences.en: His hands were shaking very badly.
sentences.zh: 他的双手抖得非常厉害。

sentences.en: And he went on disability.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始领取残疾补助。

sentences.en: I was telling my mom the other day, I said, you know, they had some shorts at Walmart that were like five bucks.
sentences.zh: 前几天我跟我妈说，我说，你知道吗，沃尔玛有些短裤才五美元。

sentences.en: She's like, oh, that's not bad.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，那还不错。

sentences.en: I'm thinking, what?
sentences.zh: 我在想，什么？

sentences.en: Five dollars for brand new shorts?
sentences.zh: 全新的短裤才五美元？

sentences.en: And then she's like, yeah, that's not bad.
sentences.zh: 然后她又说，是啊，那还不错。

sentences.en: I said, well, you know, technically no.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，你知道，严格来说并不是。

sentences.en: For somebody like Abe, from his perspective, from his economic, you know, the very, very lowest rung in the economic ladder,
sentences.zh: 对于像阿贝这样的人，从他的角度来看，从他的经济状况来看，你知道，处于经济阶梯的最底层，

sentences.en: somebody who drives to school in a car that their parents bought them and has the latest iPhone and has the fancy new shoes is rich.
sentences.zh: 那些开着父母买的车去上学、用着最新款iPhone、穿着时髦新鞋的人就是富人。

sentences.en: So it felt like an outcaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以他感觉自己像个局外人。

sentences.en: Yeah, he was very much part of a social class that was not privileged in a place that had a lot of privilege sort of out in the open for people to see.
sentences.zh: 是的，他确实属于一个非特权阶层，而他所处的地方却有着许多显而易见的特权。

sentences.en: I think that had a profound effect on how he saw himself, who he ended up associating with and having his friends and, you know, his own confidence in himself.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对他的自我认知、他最终结交的朋友以及他自己的自信心产生了深远的影响。

sentences.en: And that was ended up being a major problem for his life because, you know, he got into this this trouble with this mosque.
sentences.zh: 这最终成了他生活中的一个大问题，因为，你知道，他卷入了那座清真寺的麻烦事里。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't think he chose the best of friends sometimes.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我觉得他有时交友不慎。

sentences.en: And he's really, and the one friend he trusted is 100% with everything, really did a doozy on him.
sentences.zh: 他真的很信任那个朋友，百分之百信任，结果却被对方狠狠地坑了一把。

sentences.en: Kristen, the mother, was driving them somewhere and Craig made this sort of offhand comment.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀，也就是母亲，当时正开车送他们去某处，克雷格随口说了句不经意的话。

sentences.en: They saw a woman in a hijab drive by in a very fancy car and he said, oh, look at that sand monkey in a Cadillac.
sentences.zh: 他们看到一个戴着头巾的女人开着一辆豪车经过，他说，哦，看那个开凯迪拉克的沙猴子。

sentences.en: And so it wasn't even like he was sort of afraid or kind of worried about them as the other.
sentences.zh: 所以这甚至不是因为他害怕或者担心他们这些“异类”。

sentences.en: It was like he was jealous.
sentences.zh: 感觉他更像是嫉妒。

sentences.en: Why jealous?
sentences.zh: 为什么嫉妒？

sentences.en: So the Muslims are, for the most part, affluent people.
sentences.zh: 因为穆斯林大多是富裕阶层。

sentences.en: They are the doctors, they're businessmen.
sentences.zh: 他们是医生，是商人。

sentences.en: They are seen as affluent people, both, you know, by the kids in the high school and by people in the society.
sentences.zh: 无论是高中里的孩子，还是社会上的人，都认为他们是富人。

sentences.en: So they are, yes, they're Muslims, but in some ways it's just as important that they're rich.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，他们是穆斯林，但在某种程度上，他们有钱这一点同样重要。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无保留、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Remember you were talking, you told me about that you had a dream.
sentences.zh: 记得你之前跟我说过，你做了一个梦。

sentences.en: Tell me about that dream.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲那个梦。

sentences.en: That dream, oh my God.
sentences.zh: 那个梦，天哪。

sentences.en: I'm waking up in this thick ground, and I'm just, I stand up, and I'm looking around, and there's people all over me.
sentences.zh: 我醒来时身处一片厚实的土地上，我站起来，环顾四周，周围全是人。

sentences.en: I don't really notice where I'm at at first, but I get up, and I start walking.
sentences.zh: 起初我没注意到自己在哪，但我站起来开始走动。

sentences.en: And I'm looking at all these people in their faces, and their kids are crying.
sentences.zh: 我看着所有人的脸，他们的孩子在哭泣。

sentences.en: And there's women that are, like, holding their husbands, and they've got tears, and their husbands are just, like, very, like, very scorned, very upset by what they're looking at.
sentences.zh: 还有些女人抱着她们的丈夫，眼里含着泪水，而她们的丈夫看起来非常愤怒，对眼前所见感到非常不满。

sentences.en: And I'm walking through, walking through this crowd of people, and I look forward, and there's the mosque, and I see all the spray paint and all that shit all over it.
sentences.zh: 我穿过人群，向前看去，那是清真寺，我看到上面全是喷漆和那些乱七八糟的东西。

sentences.en: And I'm just, I look at them, and I turn around, and then they're all going from looking at the mosque to looking at me.
sentences.zh: 我看着他们，转过身，然后他们所有人都从看着清真寺转为看着我。

sentences.en: And I think it's, like, almost like the dream was trying to tell me, you're the monster that you've always fought against, you know?
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就像是梦在试图告诉我，你就是你一直以来所对抗的那个怪物，你明白吗？

sentences.en: So, Sabrina, Abe just said goodbye to his mother, and now he's in jail because she can't pay for his bail.
sentences.zh: 所以，萨布丽娜，阿贝刚刚和母亲告别，现在他被关进监狱，因为她付不起保释金。

sentences.en: He is awaiting sentencing.
sentences.zh: 他正在等待判决。

sentences.en: Then what happens?
sentences.zh: 然后会发生什么？

sentences.en: There was a back and forth about what the charge should be for Abraham.
sentences.zh: 关于亚伯拉罕应该被控什么罪名，双方有过一番争论。

sentences.en: Fundamentally, what was his crime?
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，他的罪行是什么？

sentences.en: According to the police, he wasn't actually doing the writing.
sentences.zh: 据警方称，他实际上并没有动手涂鸦。

sentences.en: He was the one that was the lookout.
sentences.zh: 他当时负责望风。

sentences.en: Also, obviously, culpable, but, you know, did that merit a felony charge?
sentences.zh: 当然也有罪，但是，你知道，这值得被控重罪吗？

sentences.en: Arkansas does not have a hate crime statute, but the prosecutor was taking it very, very seriously and sort of, in some ways, using it as an example, I think, of, you know,
sentences.zh: 阿肯色州没有仇恨犯罪法，但检察官非常非常严肃地对待这件事，在某种程度上，我认为他将其作为一个例子，用来警示，你知道，

sentences.en: what will happen to you if you decide that you're going to, you know, do an act of bigotry.
sentences.zh: 如果你决定去实施偏执行为，你会面临什么样的后果。

sentences.en: But then something very strange happens.
sentences.zh: 但随后发生了一件非常奇怪的事。

sentences.en: It was after a Friday prayer, one afternoon, two, two, three o'clock, you know, people are sort of standing around talking, prayers are over, and they get this knock on the door.
sentences.zh: 那是周五礼拜之后，一天下午，两三点钟，你知道，人们还在那儿站着聊天，礼拜结束了，然后他们听到有人敲门。

sentences.en: A man enters.
sentences.zh: 一个男人走了进来。

sentences.en: He's taken off his shoes, sign of respect, which not many people know, so they were sort of impressed by that.
sentences.zh: 他脱掉了鞋子，这是一种尊重的表现，没多少人知道这一点，所以他们对此印象深刻。

sentences.en: And he introduces himself as Noah Davis.
sentences.zh: 他自我介绍说是诺亚·戴维斯。

sentences.en: And I was really surprised that he would walk in.
sentences.zh: 我真的很惊讶他会走进来。

sentences.en: I thought that was courageous of him.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他很有勇气。

sentences.en: If I were in his shoes, I wouldn't do this.
sentences.zh: 如果换做是我，我不会这么做。

sentences.en: And he says, I just want to tell you that I am the brother of Abraham Davis who vandalized your mosque,
sentences.zh: 他说，我只是想告诉你们，我是亚伯拉罕·戴维斯的哥哥，他破坏了你们的清真寺，

sentences.en: and I have a letter from him that I want to read to you that I need to deliver to you because he has something to say to you.
sentences.zh: 我有一封他写的信想读给你们听，我必须把它交给你们，因为他有话要对你们说。

sentences.en: And so he sits down and he reads, and they listen.
sentences.zh: 于是他坐下来读信，他们静静地听着。

sentences.en: Dear Masjid al-Salam Mosque, I know you guys probably don't want to hear from me at all, but I really want to just pretty much get this to y'all.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的萨拉姆清真寺，我知道你们可能根本不想听到我的声音，但我真的只想把这封信传达给你们。

sentences.en: I'm so sorry about having a hand in vandalizing your mosque.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉参与了破坏你们清真寺的行动。

sentences.en: It was wrong, and y'all did not deserve to have that done to you.
sentences.zh: 那是错误的，你们不应该遭受这样的对待。

sentences.en: I hurt y'all, and I'm haunted by it.
sentences.zh: 我伤害了你们，我为此感到愧疚不安。

sentences.en: I don't know what's going to happen to me, and to be honest, that's really scary.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我会面临什么，老实说，这真的很可怕。

sentences.en: But I just wouldn't want to keep going without trying to make amends.
sentences.zh: 但我不想就这样继续下去，而不尝试去弥补。

sentences.en: I wish I could undo the pain I helped to cause.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能挽回我造成的痛苦。

sentences.en: I used to walk by your mosque a lot and ask myself why I would do that.
sentences.zh: 我过去常经过你们的清真寺，问自己为什么要那样做。

sentences.en: I don't even hate Muslims, or anyone for that matter.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不恨穆斯林，或者说不恨任何人。

sentences.en: All in all, I just want to say I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，我只想说我很抱歉。

sentences.en: Y'all are good people who do good work in the community.
sentences.zh: 你们是好人，在社区里做了很多好事。

sentences.en: Sincerely, Abraham Davis.
sentences.zh: 诚挚地，亚伯拉罕·戴维斯。

sentences.en: So, suddenly, the mosque people are standing holding this letter thinking, wow, we didn't expect this.
sentences.zh: 所以，突然间，清真寺的人们拿着这封信站着，心想，哇，我们没想到会这样。

sentences.en: We didn't expect any of this.
sentences.zh: 我们完全没料到会发生这些。

sentences.en: They had a long discussion about what they should do, but they came to the conclusion that they wanted to ask for mercy and leniency on Abraham's behalf.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了长时间的讨论，商量该怎么做，但最终决定，他们想为亚伯拉罕请求宽大处理。

sentences.en: And we had a feeling that this was heartfelt.
sentences.zh: 我们感觉到这是发自内心的。

sentences.en: It really meant that.
sentences.zh: 他是真心的。

sentences.en: And because of this, we took it very seriously.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我们非常认真地对待这件事。

sentences.en: And I promised Noah at that point that if asked, I would definitely speak on his behalf and try to have the court have mercy on him.
sentences.zh: 当时我向诺亚承诺，如果需要，我一定会为他求情，并尝试让法庭对他宽大处理。

sentences.en: The main, the president of the mosque, he's a pediatric pulmonologist who came from Syria in 1980.
sentences.zh: 清真寺的负责人是一位儿科肺科医生，1980年从叙利亚来到这里。

sentences.en: Dr. Nostri said, you know, we went to talk to the prosecuting attorney for eight.
sentences.zh: 诺斯特里医生说，你知道，我们去和检察官谈了八次。

sentences.en: I felt sorry for these kids, and especially, especially Abraham.
sentences.zh: 我为这些孩子感到难过，尤其是亚伯拉罕。

sentences.en: We did not this to affect their lives forever in any way, shape, or form.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望这件事以任何方式、任何形式永远影响他们的生活。

sentences.en: And because of this, we did not want this judgment to be a felony.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我们不希望这个判决成为重罪。

sentences.en: We wanted it to be a misdemeanor.
sentences.zh: 我们希望这只是轻罪。

sentences.en: And actually, when we talked to the assistant prosecuting attorney initially, he agreed with us, and he actually liked this idea.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当我们最初与助理检察官交谈时，他同意我们的观点，甚至很赞同这个想法。

sentences.en: But as the weeks went on, and in the end, that wasn't what happened.
sentences.zh: 但随着几周过去，最终结果并非如此。

sentences.en: So what did happen in the courtroom when the judge delivered Abe's sentence?
sentences.zh: 那么当法官宣布阿贝的判决时，法庭上发生了什么？

sentences.en: So Kristen and Noah arrived at the courtroom exactly nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀和诺亚准时在九点到达了法庭。

sentences.en: They were very nervous.
sentences.zh: 他们非常紧张。

sentences.en: They had on their best clothes.
sentences.zh: 他们穿上了最好的衣服。

sentences.en: About 11.15 a.m., Craig and Abe sort of shuffle up to the front to the judge.
sentences.zh: 大约上午11点15分，克雷格和阿贝挪步走到法官面前。

sentences.en: The judge gives them this sort of very harrumphing lecture, you know, this was a very stupid thing that you've done.
sentences.zh: 法官对他们进行了一番严厉的训斥，你知道，你们做了一件非常愚蠢的事情。

sentences.en: You should be ashamed of yourselves.
sentences.zh: 你们应该为自己感到羞耻。

sentences.en: You were very lucky that the victims aren't pressing for more, you know, justice for themselves because you would have gone to prison for six years.
sentences.zh: 你们很幸运，受害者没有要求更多的正义，否则你们会被判入狱六年。

sentences.en: So the judge announced his sentence, and it was not to the liking of the mosque.
sentences.zh: 法官宣布了判决，这并不符合清真寺方面的意愿。

sentences.en: It was the following.
sentences.zh: 判决如下。

sentences.en: According to the law, this is a felony, and it's not a misdemeanor.
sentences.zh: 根据法律，这是一项重罪，而不是轻罪。

sentences.en: I mean, I didn't know that if the victim, which is us, if he asked for leniency, then the law does not allow that in Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不知道如果受害者，也就是我们，请求宽大处理，阿肯色州的法律是不允许的。

sentences.en: I didn't know that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这一点。

sentences.en: But the two bystander young men, Ezra and Abraham, got three-year suspended sentences.
sentences.zh: 但那两个旁观的年轻人，埃兹拉和亚伯拉罕，被判处三年缓刑。

sentences.en: So what that means is they have to be on good behavior for three full years.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们必须在整整三年内表现良好。

sentences.en: That means no drugs, no drinking, no going to bars, working, and most importantly, consistently paying on their $3,000, 200 fines and restitution chunk of money
sentences.zh: 这意味着不能吸毒、不能酗酒、不能去酒吧、必须工作，最重要的是，要持续支付他们那3200美元的罚款和赔偿金，

sentences.en: that they owe the court system now.
sentences.zh: 这是他们现在欠法院系统的钱。

sentences.en: And that's, you know, perhaps going to be the biggest hurdle for Abraham since it's a lot of money to come up with for his family.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这可能是亚伯拉罕面临的最大障碍，因为对他家人来说，这是一笔巨款。

sentences.en: Craig gets a stricter sentence, a six-year suspended sentence.
sentences.zh: 克雷格受到的判决更严厉，是六年缓刑。

sentences.en: So he has all of the same conditions, but for six years instead of three.
sentences.zh: 所以他的条件是一样的，但期限是六年而不是三年。

sentences.en: The mosque was hoping that the case would be sealed.
sentences.zh: 清真寺方面曾希望案件能够封存。

sentences.en: He could not have to check the box.
sentences.zh: 这样他就不用在表格上勾选那个选项了。

sentences.en: The felony wouldn't be a problem because it would be expunged.
sentences.zh: 重罪不会成为问题，因为它会被抹除记录。

sentences.en: Check the box meaning he would not be having to acknowledge for all future employment or background checks that he was a convicted felon.
sentences.zh: 勾选那个选项意味着他不必在未来的所有就业或背景调查中承认自己曾是重罪犯。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Did you ask the prosecuting attorney why, when Hisham and others didn't want Abe to get a felony, and they're the victims, so presumably their views would have a lot of weight,
sentences.zh: 你有没有问过检察官，既然希沙姆和其他人都不希望阿贝被判重罪，而他们又是受害者，理应有很大的话语权，

sentences.en: why they went ahead with the felony?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们还是坚持以重罪起诉？

sentences.en: I did ask him that.
sentences.zh: 我确实问过他。

sentences.en: He's a thoughtful guy, the prosecuting attorney.
sentences.zh: 他是个很有思想的人，那位检察官。

sentences.en: He said, you know, look, actions have consequences.
sentences.zh: 他说，你看，行为是有后果的。

sentences.en: We take into account what the victims want, but it is ultimately we, the state, that make the argument and make the charge.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑受害者的意愿，但最终是我们，也就是州政府，来提出论点并进行指控。

sentences.en: And we believe that this was what was fair in this case.
